title: NBA: Gilgeous-Alexander leads Thunder past Cavs, Grizzlies beaten
summary: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander erupted for 43 points as the Oklahoma City Thunder halted their two-game losing streak with a battling 117-112 road victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers on Monday.
